item_1_acceptance_criteria.description: No github.com/nbd-wtf/go-nostr imports remain in internal/adapters/nostr/**, internal/nostrutil/**, or internal/controlplane/signer.go.
Core adapter publish, subscribe, AUTH, EOSE, CLOSED, validation, dedupe, and projection tests compile and pass against latest fiatjaf.com/nostr.
Relay subscription migration preserves event-driven EOSE semantics and does not use timeout-based completion for catch-up.
Inbound relay events remain validated before persistence/dispatch using canonical event ID, pubkey, signature, timestamp, and tag checks.
Downstream go-nostr consumers outside Item 1 are not migrated in this slice and are tracked as blockers for later items.
tests: rg github.com/nbd-wtf/go-nostr internal cmd pkg output captured

item_2_acceptance_criteria.description: No github.com/nbd-wtf/go-nostr imports or go-nostr references remain in the Item 2 protocol/NIP consumer scope.
Scoped protocol/NIP consumer packages compile and pass targeted tests against fiatjaf.com/nostr.
Downstream publish/sign/auth/encryption paths reuse canonical helpers and preserve OK/AUTH/CLOSED/EOSE/validation semantics without polling/request-response shims.
tests: code review of modified scoped consumers

item_2_acceptance_criteria.description: Known compatibility or remaining migration gaps are tracked in Beads rather than comments or handoff prose.
tests: bahia-ncxo created for NIP-44 stored-secret compatibility
